summary: First-finish smoke tests for Explore Wisata Sumut. Backend endpoints (destinations CRUD, filters, auth, wishlist, admin RBAC) and frontend flows (home/directory/detail/wishlist/admin) all working via public URL. One minor observation: destination detail page has a hydration warning (<span> child of <option> in Directory currency label) but non-blocking.
passed: GET /api/destinations returns 5 seeded destinations across 5 categories
GET /api/destinations?featured=true returns 4 featured (Danau Toba, Pantai Cermin, Istana Maimun, Bukit Lawang)
POST /api/auth/register creates user with role=user, cookie set
GET /api/auth/me returns authenticated user via cookie
Wishlist POST/GET/DELETE work for authenticated user (200 OK)
Admin POST/PUT/DELETE destinations work; non-admin POST -> 403
Home page renders 4 featured destination cards and 5 category tiles
Category tile navigates to /explore?category=nature and filters to 1 card
Directory search 'toba' filters to 1 card; budget<=50000 filters to 3 cards
Destination detail shows Leaflet map and wishlist toggle
Wishlist toggle when logged out redirects to /login
Admin login succeeds, nav-admin visible, /wishlist page shows added item after logged-in wishlist add
Admin add flow creates new destination and it appears in list (verified UI + cleaned up)

failed.issue: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in Directory budget select (currency label uses data-ve-dynamic span inside <option>)
failed.evidence: console error captured at /explore: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' in Directory.jsx line 81

action_items: Optional: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Directory.jsx line ~81, avoid wrapping the option text in a translated span (render plain text {t.common.currency} without span wrapper) to remove hydration warning.
